Estimate: the meal has a Greek-style salad (tomato, cucumber, feta, dressing) and 5 sushi rolls (maki with chicken and cucumber), plus soy sauce, a dressing cup, and water. Water is not counted as food energy.

Sushi: 5 thick pieces at about 40 g each is about 200 g, at roughly 1.4 kcal/g, so about 280 kcal.

Salad: about 180 g, with tomato, cucumber, and about 40 g feta (about 100 kcal), plus dressing of about 15 g oil (about 120 kcal). Vegetables add about 40 kcal, so the salad is about 250 kcal and 195 g with dressing.

Soy sauce is about 15 g and 10 kcal.

Total: about 540 kcal and about 410 g.
